# FIXTURE: synthetic interviewer bundle (fictional person "Alex Rivera")
## LinkedIn profile text (synthetic)
Alex Rivera — Director of Product, Checkout & Payments, Fabrikam Goods (2022–present)
Previously: Group PM, Payments, Wingtip Toys (2018–2022); Senior PM, Marketplace, Coho Winery Online (2014–2018); Analyst, Lucerne Publishing (2011–2014).
Education: BS Industrial Engineering. 
About: I build checkout experiences that are boring in the best way: fast, trusted, and invisible. I care about experimentation that changes decisions, not experimentation theater. Mentor with a local PM bootcamp.
Posts (last 6 months): (1) "Your guardrail metric is your real strategy" — 1.2K reactions. (2) "Why we killed our one-click checkout test after it won" — essay on long-term retention vs short-term conversion. (3) Hiring post for Senior PM, Checkout Experience. (4) Conference talk recap: 'Payments reliability as a product feature'.
Skills: Experimentation, Payments, Product Strategy, SQL, Team Leadership.
## Recommendations received (synthetic)
### Recommendation from Sam Okafor
Sam worked with Alex for 2 years. "Alex remembers every commitment made in a review. In our quarterly planning Alex coaches PMs to separate the metric from the goal, which frustrated some of us at first but saved the org from at least two bad launches. Alex also backs the team publicly and challenges privately. When our checkout redesign slipped, Alex took the heat with the VP and then sat down with each engineer to understand what went wrong. I'd work for Alex again in a heartbeat. The one thing to know: Alex will ask you what you would cut if you had half the time, and expects a real answer, not a hedge."
